_comment: Generated by tools/learn-routes.js — do not edit by hand; re-run the tool. Berth keys are AREA:BERTH. Every figure carries n and the dates it came from. Read by the berth-first engine (src/berth-first/routes.js, v1 step 3+).

timetable.note: one full extract: days before it fall back to permanent schedules where an expired one-day overlay ran

sameBerths.rule: steps by the same train in two areas within 1 s vote from=from and to=to (1 vote same second, 0.5 a second apart); each berth the other's favourite with at least 5 votes and twice the runner-up's score, a matching berth number counting double (national-log days only)
sameBerths.note: berths two areas both describe; routes name them by the crossing's own area where it has a name
